subject: Create Claude Code hooks plugin for Johnny
description:
Create the Claude Code plugin with hooks for automatic observation capture, sending to Agent Hub.

**Project:** Claude Code plugin → Agent Hub (~/agent-hub/)

**Skills:** Use `/hook-development` for Claude Code hook patterns.

**Scope:**
- Create plugin structure at ~/.claude/plugins/johnny/
- Implement PostToolUse hook for tool observation capture
- Implement SessionStart hook for session initialization
- Implement Stop hook for session summary generation
- Create API client to send observations to Agent Hub's /api/johnny/* endpoints

**Plugin Structure:**
```
~/.claude/plugins/johnny/
├── plugin.json
├── hooks/
│   ├── hooks.json
│   ├── post-tool-use.ts
│   ├── session-start.ts
│   └── stop.ts
└── lib/
    └── johnny-client.ts
```

**Hook Behaviors:**
- PostToolUse: Capture tool name, input, response → POST to Agent Hub /api/johnny/observations
- SessionStart: Create session record via Agent Hub API, inject previous context
- Stop: Generate session summary via Agent Hub API, promote learnings

**Files:**
- ~/.claude/plugins/johnny/** (new plugin)
- Plugin TypeScript source files

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Plugin structure created
- [ ] hooks.json defines all hooks
- [ ] PostToolUse captures tool calls
- [ ] SessionStart initializes session
- [ ] Stop generates summary
- [ ] API client sends to Agent Hub /api/johnny/*
- [ ] Privacy tag filtering (`<private>`) implemented
- [ ] Plugin loads in Claude Code without errors
- [ ] Observations appear in Agent Hub Johnny dashboard

**Context Check:** If >= 60%, /compact first. If >= 75%, /commit_it then /compact.

**Completion:** Run /commit_it after verification passes.
